titleEn: Sorry. I Will Pick It Up Too!

pages.text: Thump! Bung leaped from the walkway onto Grandpa's boat. A big rock sent neatly stacked cargo tumbling. "What do I do?" Bung froze.
Grandpa had stacked it all morning. Bung thought, "I should say sorry." A burning face, but a firmly shut mouth.
Bung slipped behind the awning to hide. Silently, Grandpa gathered cargo one piece at a time. Thump, thump, thump.
Behind the awning felt dark and stuffy. A heavy load seemed to press on Bung's chest. Bung buried a face in the knees.
The awning lifted a little. In came Ddori, taking Bung's hand and pushing outward. "Ah! Ah!" Ddori pointed at the cargo.
Bung drew Ddori's hand close and came out. Grandpa straightened and looked. Bung breathed in deeply.
"Grandpa, my jumping knocked it down. Sorry. I will pick it up too!" Saying it made the chest feel lighter. Grandpa nodded.
"Good. Heavy things first." He set big cargo at the bottom. Bung put smaller pieces above. Ddori struggled over with the smallest.
"One, do not hide! Two, say sorry! Three, clean up together!" Bung placed the last piece. The stack stood neater than before.
Grandpa hugged both together. "One sorry, and the fallen stack stands again." "I will board gently now. Sorry. I will pick it up too!" Bung touched the neat cargo.
